title: Light Silky British Cream Pudding
description: A light and silky British-inspired dessert, featuring the rich flavors of double cream and yuzu-cure, with a hint of lemon zest.

ingredients.name: Egg Yolks
ingredients.notes: Use large egg yolks for best results.

instructions: Combine egg yolks, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract in a heatproof bowl.
Set the bowl over a saucepan of simmering water and whisk constantly until the mixture thickens.
Remove the bowl from the heat and slowly pour in the double cream, whisking continuously.
Add the lemon zest, yuzu juice, and salt, and whisk until fully incorporated.
Strain the mixture into a clean bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Just before serving, whip the coconut cream (if using) until stiff peaks form and fold into the chilled mixture.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional lemon zest if desired.
